name: meetoluwaseyi
description: meetoluwaseyi.com: personal brand site for Oluwaseyi Oshunwusi (MERN, two moods: playful and serious)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meetoluwaseyi/web && npm run build -w @meetoluwaseyi/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
